gate_results.rationale: Technology reaches end-of-life within 12 months (technology_eol_months is 4). IT-EOL-001 is risk-acceptable and approved conditionally under standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-01-IT-1, resulting in GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS with action CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN.

Review facts confirm that business criticality is High while multi_az and multi_region are both false, triggering ARCH-HA-001 (disposition REWORK, not risk-acceptable). Additionally, reversibility_status is 'missing', triggering ARCH-REV-001 (disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable). By policy precedence (REWORK > GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS), the overall gate disposition is REWORK, requiring actions REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY and COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE. Authorization is not required for REWORK under the gate contract policy.

Review of authoritative security facts indicates three non-compliant conditions: a shared service principal is in use (SEC-IAM-002, REWORK), security-relevant logs are not exported to SIEM (SEC-LOG-001, REWORK), and 2 critical vulnerabilities remain open (SEC-VULN-001, NO_GO). None of these findings permit risk acceptance under the policy. Following the gate precedence hierarchy, the presence of SEC-VULN-001 dictates an overall gate disposition of NO_GO. Per the gate contract policy, NO_GO decisions require authorization.

Authoritative review facts confirm that log_export_clause is 'missing' while business criticality is 'High', which triggers LEGAL-LOG-001. All other legal criteria are compliant (dpa_status is 'signed', liability_cap_multiplier is 1 with security_carveout true, audit_right is 'full', exit_assistance_days is 90, ip_ownership is 'customer', insurance_valid is true, and signing_authority_valid is true). LEGAL-LOG-001 is risk-acceptable and has been approved with conditions under the active standing mandate from risk owner Lucas Martin-12006-RO (MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1), resulting in a GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS disposition requiring action ADD_LOG_EXPORT_CLAUSE.

Authoritative compliance review facts indicate that accessibility_status is 'major_findings' (triggering COMP-A11Y-001, REWORK) and export_control is 'pending' (triggering COMP-EXPORT-002, SUSPENSION). COMP-EXPORT-002 does not permit risk acceptance, so the standing mandate covering only risk-acceptable findings cannot resolve all findings. Per decision policy priority (GO < GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS < REWORK < SUSPENSION < NO_GO), the overall gate disposition is SUSPENSION, requiring authorization and the actions REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY and COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW.

Review of authoritative general review facts shows requested funding (€500,000) exceeds approved budget (€350,000), triggering GEN-BUDGET-001 (disposition SUSPENSION). Additionally, the upstream Security gate returned NO_GO, triggering GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (disposition NO_GO). Per the normative decision hierarchy (GO < GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS < REWORK < SUSPENSION < NO_GO), the overall gate disposition is NO_GO. GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO does not permit risk acceptance, precluding conditional approval under the standing mandate. NO_GO dispositions require authorization.
